name: Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure
summary: In Westfall, Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure sends you inland after a clue found by the shore. The trail leads east from the coast toward a barrel near ruined stonework.

sections.title: A Trail of Inland Riddles
sections.body: Captain Sanders sends you inland after the first cipher is solved. The clue points away from the shore and up the rocky bluffs, toward Westfall's main roads.

sections.title: Ruins Along the Road
sections.body: An old chimney among roadside ruins marks the next stop. A discarded barrel nearby hides another message, and the ruined farmstead gives Sanders a landmark for the trail.

faq.answer: Captain Sanders was a pirate captain who sailed along Westfall's coasts. He scattered clues and riddles across the region for anyone seeking his hidden wealth.

faq.q: Where does this clue send you?
faq.answer: The clue sends you east from the western sea, up the bluffs and toward the road. Beside an old stone chimney in the ruins, a broken barrel hides the next piece of the puzzle.

faq.q: Why did Sanders hide his treasure in pieces?
faq.answer: Sanders divided the directions into several riddles to keep rivals and the authorities from finding his hidden wealth. Only a persistent, resourceful seeker can follow the trail to its final cache.

faq.q: Is the treasure hunt dangerous to follow?
faq.answer: The clues themselves are parchment and old containers, but Westfall's roads and fields bring danger. Wandering beasts, prowling gnolls, and hostile members of the Defias Brotherhood threaten travelers near abandoned homesteads.

faq.q: What kind of ruins is the barrel hidden near?
faq.answer: The barrel is beside the crumbling stone chimney of a ruined building near the road. Westfall has many homesteads left abandoned or demolished during recent years of turmoil.

faq.q: Does this quest reveal the treasure itself?
faq.answer: No. This step reveals another clue. Sanders laid out several stages across the region before the actual prize can be found.

angles.text: As a Rogue, you can use stealth and cunning to decipher pirate ciphers and search abandoned ruins for forgotten spoils.
As an Alliance traveler, you can follow Sanders' trail along Westfall's lawless coast and untended inland roads while the local militia struggles against organized outlaws.
